name: Celeb Komochizuma Inwai Choukyou ~Ryoujoku Kanrinin~
original_name: セレブ子持ち妻淫猥調教～凌辱管理人～
source:
Tetsuo is an apartment caretaker, and is the personification of sexual desire. This time, his target is Etsuko, who has just moved to his apartment. He approaches her with Sayaka, who is Tetsuo's first sex slave.
